t: Reimbursement for the tax imposed upon the vendor shall be collected by the vendor from the purchaser on all sales the gross receipts from which are subject to the tax imposed by this title so far as it can be done. It shall be the duty of each purchaser in the District to reimburse the vendor, as provided in section 127 of this title, for the tax imposed by this title. Such reimbursement of tax shall be a debt from the purchaser to the vendor and shall be recoverable at law in the same manner as other debts.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that "recoverable at law" grants a right to sue, but it only lets a vendor collect a private debt from a purchaser; it is not a suit against, or objection to, a federal government decision. The section just sets out how a sales tax is passed on from vendor to purchaser in the District. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, or advisory body that brings outside parties into a government decision.
fable.s: Such reimbursement of tax shall be a debt from the purchaser to the vendor and shall be recoverable at law in the same manner as other debts.

qwen_block.w: This section establishes a private contractual obligation between vendors and purchasers regarding the reimbursement of sales tax. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or participation by outside parties in a federal government decision. The interaction is strictly between private entities (vendor and purchaser) regarding a financial debt, not a federal policy or regulatory decision.
qwen_block.s: Reimbursement for the tax imposed upon the vendor shall be collected by the vendor from the purchaser on all sales the gross receipts from which are subject to the tax imposed by this title so far as it can be done. It shall be the duty of each purchaser in the District to reimburse the vendor, as provided in section 127 of this title, for the tax imposed by this title. Such reimbursement of tax shall be a debt from the purchaser to the vendor and shall be recoverable at law in the same manner as other debts.

opus.w: This section says a vendor must collect sales tax reimbursement from purchasers, and that the purchaser's duty to pay is a private debt. The phrase 'recoverable at law' only lets a vendor sue a purchaser to collect that debt. It does not let anyone challenge or object to a government decision. No outside party is consulted or given a role in any government decision, so this is not participation.
opus.s: Such reimbursement of tax shall be a debt from the purchaser to the vendor and shall be recoverable at law in the same manner as other debts.
opus.b: The tempting reading is that "recoverable at law" gives someone a right to sue. But the lawsuit it allows is between a vendor and a purchaser over a private debt. Nobody gets a right to sue over a government decision, and no outside party is consulted before one.

qwen_chat.w: This section mandates the collection of tax reimbursement from purchasers by vendors and defines this reimbursement as a recoverable debt. It describes a financial obligation and legal remedy between private parties (vendor and purchaser) or regarding private debts, rather than a process where the federal government consults or coordinates with outside parties before making a decision. There is no advisory board, public comment period, or consultation with states/tribes involved in a federal decision-making process.
qwen_chat.s: Reimbursement for the tax imposed upon the vendor shall be collected by the vendor from the purchaser on all sales the gross receipts from which are subject to the tax imposed by this title so far as it can be done.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the "purchaser" is an outside party interacting with the government (via the vendor), but the text describes a private commercial transaction (reimbursement of tax between vendor and purchaser) and a legal debt recovery mechanism. It does not involve the federal government consulting with, coordinating with, or seeking input from outside parties before making a decision. The interaction is purely financial and legal between private parties or regarding private debts.
